ref: #48 owner decision Q4: case-insensitive is String.compareToIgnoreCase; #2 §4 sort: "within the existing or set context", stable, numeric or lexicographic (case-sensitive or not), ascending or descending [SAP✓ STD]
note: caseInsensitive over the input of fn/sort/002. compareToIgnoreCase compares by code point, not by UTF-16 code unit, so 😀 (U+1F600) comes after Ａ (folded to U+FF41): z, ﬀ, Ａ, 😀, against z, 😀, ﬀ, Ａ for lexicographic. ﬀ has no single-character upper case and stays U+FB00. R1 joins the contexts S1 keeps, so All shows each context's order in turn. Observe in SAP PO (#33).
